This '''barn''' was the property of [[barq]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] [[Hefrar Birhan]]. It was located beside his house on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he hid [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]], who was on the run from [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Ghez Hokan]]'s militia, in the barn for a couple of [[Standard day/Legends|days]] until she met up with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Darman Skirata|RC-1136]].<ref name="hc">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>
